methodology.model: fixed-count closed-loop; each worker dispatches its next operation only after consuming the previous response body
methodology.latency: performance.now dispatch through complete response body; includes HTTP, protocol and network errors; milliseconds; nearest-rank percentiles
limitations: closed-loop observed-client distributions have coordinated omission and do not establish open-loop saturation capacity
clients and all app instances share this host; PostgreSQL/LocalStack may share Docker and other host workloads; not an isolated hardware experiment
SQL sampler, HTTP metrics scraping and log consumption add observer overhead
setup, warmup, migration, metric snapshots, outbox drain and reconciliation are excluded from measured request throughput

workload.ordering: index-based round-robin instance/wallet; deterministic operation identities within isolated database
workload.duplicate: all measured requests share one identical payload and idempotency key; exactly one committed debit; replays are expected successes

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

outbox.sampleSchedule: nonoverlapping fixed-delay; query time adds to nominal interval; observedAt records actual spacing; first/last observations bracket requests

metrics.window: request dispatch through completed outbox drain
